analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($63,068.99) vs SMA5/20/50 ($63,455.91/$64,417.59/$63,342.95) — Mixed position, trading below short-term SMA5/20 but above mid-term SMA50.
· Significant distance below SMA100/200 ($68,750.49/$71,123.11) confirms weak mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (7.8%) + current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.4 → 45.4) — Consolidation in neutral zone, weakening recovery after entering oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histogram -82.0963 → -244.5775) — Improving within negative territory, maintaining bottom-building signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $64,417.59) — Trading around the middle band, with reduced volatility indicated by a 6.01% band width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($62,553.19) — Key support zone between 52-week low ($57,747.77) and Pivot S1 ($61,214.32).
· Swing Resistance ($64,443.71) — Near-term resistance adjacent to Bollinger Band Middle Band and Pivot PP ($64,062.19).
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns — No clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern, indicating a consolidation range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.64x vs 5-day average) — Low confidence in price movement due to subdued volume.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Lack of directional conviction, maintaining wait-and-see conditions.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI continues to consolidate in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram maintains its improving signal, following the previous assessment's flow.
